name: – After § 3 – Am 6
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the threat of war crimes, the escalating violations of international humanitarian law and the human rights situation in El-Obeid, Sudan
part_text: 3a. Is very concerned about the destabilising effect of mass displacement on the region and that the conflict continues to fuel irregular migration flows towards Europe, challenging social cohesion and public security across Europe; stresses the need for regional solutions and responsible burden-sharing within the region;
